E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Late Show: Jay pulls strings to get a reservation at a hot new restaurant. Unfortunately, everyone is running late. (S5 Ep5)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Help: Jay and Manny aren't happy when Gloria hires a too-good-to-be-true male nanny. Frank's in town and feeling lonely, so Phil and Jay take him out to get his groove back. (S5 Ep6)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Hotel Hell
E4Plus1.uk.description: Landoll's Mohican Castle: Gordon Ramsay visits a custom-built, multi-million-dollar hotel in Loudonville, Ohio. Can he help the struggling business and its overworked owner? (S3 Ep8)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's 24 Hours to Hell and Back
E4Plus1.uk.description: Lowery's Seafood Restaurant: Gordon revamps Lowery's Seafood in Tappahannock, Virginia, where he finds two brothers - the owner and the manager - at loggerheads. (S3 Ep1)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's 24 Hours to Hell and Back
E4Plus1.uk.description: Blend on Main: Gordon Ramsay and his team visit struggling Blend on Main in New Jersey and give it a spectacular renovation, a new menu and hope for the future. (S3 Ep2)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's 24 Hours to Hell and Back
E4Plus1.uk.description: Caneda's White Rooster: Gordon Ramsay revamps a Cuban-inspired restaurant in Toms River, New Jersey. Owner Patty opened the place to showcase her grandmother's Cuban cooking. (S3 Ep3)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Dangerous Curves: Homer and Marge head to a log cabin for the weekend and reminisce about their early courtship. (S20 Ep5/21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Homer and Lisa Exchange Cross Words: Lisa discovers that she has a knack for crosswords and enters a tournament. But Homer thinks he can make money by betting on her to lose. (S20 Ep6/21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Ten-Per-Cent Solution: The TV network cancel Krusty the Clown's show. Can his first agent, Annie (Joan Rivers), help him craft a comeback? (S23 Ep8/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Politically Inept, with Homer Simpson: Homer gets his own political talk show after a video of his impassioned rant about how he was treated at the airport goes viral. (S23 Ep10/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Daughter Also Rises: Lisa meets an intellectual romantic who shares her passion for culture. (S23 Ep13/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: At Long Last Leave: The Simpsons are evicted from Springfield and join an off-grid community, but Marge and Homer meet hostility when they try to sneak back into town. (S23 Ep14/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: How I Wet Your Mother: Homer develops a bedwetting habit, so the family infiltrate his dreams and search for clues in his subconscious to find the source of his problem. (S23 Ep16/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Dog
E4Plus1.uk.description: (2022) Poignant road-trip comedy with Channing Tatum. A soldier with PTSD must escort a traumatised army canine to a comrade's funeral. Can man and dog save each other's lives?

E4Plus1.uk.title: Celebrity Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: The celebrities watch: This Morning, Dating Around, Mission: Impossible - Rogue Nation, Hostile Planet, Big Brother: Best Shows Ever, EastEnders and The Repair Shop. (S2 Ep4)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: The top TV includes: Strictly Come Dancing, Celebrity SAS: Who Dares Wins, A Very Royal Scandal, The Yorkshire Vet, This Morning (gurning) and My Mum, Your Dad. (S24 Ep3) [SL]
